narrative.overview: Vivatheca places understandable anatomy in an illuminated, calm working space. Deep navy creates the viewing theatre, cyan marks interaction and teaching layers, warm paper carries explanation, and coral appears only when affected anatomy or unresolved status needs attention.
keyCharacteristics: Working 3D anatomy is the focal product surface.
Dark viewing fields alternate with warm-white reading fields.
Cyan is decisive rather than decorative.
Imagery uses matte resin, paper and translucent teaching-film materials.

rules.name: The Affected-Anatomy Rule
rules.body: Coral is rare and meaningful; use it for affected anatomy, warnings and unresolved states only.

rules.name: The Plain-Voice Rule
rules.body: Headings state the benefit directly; do not add a kicker, eyebrow or medical-jargon preface above them.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Focal Rule
rules.body: Use shadows only when an element must sit physically above the reading field; dividers and tonal shifts carry ordinary structure.

dos: Do lead with the working anatomy or the people using it.
Do pair every visual with a useful alternative and text explanation.
Do label placeholder clinical and governance content plainly.
donts: Don't fabricate clinical proof or partnerships.
Don't use stock medical photography or generic SaaS card grids.
Don't use cyan or coral as low-contrast body text.
